signature.name: VTask.ofLeftInverse
signature.type: {R : Type u} -> {A : Type v} -> {B : Type w} -> [CommSemiring R] -> [Semiring A] -> [Semiring B] -> [Algebra R A] -> [Algebra R B] -> {g : B → A} -> {f : A →ₐ[R] B} -> (h : Function.LeftInverse g ⇑f) -> A ≃ₐ[R] ↥f.range

conventions.statement: The inverse map of the resulting isomorphism is defined as the composition of the range subtype inclusion into B followed by g; hence g is only required to be a left inverse of f (not a global right inverse on all of B), and the right-inverse property on f.range is automatically derived.
conventions.note: This is the defining convention distinguishing this construction from one requiring a full two-sided inverse.

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) (A : Type*) (B : Type*) [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Semiring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] (g : B → A) (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (h : Function.LeftInverse g ⇑f) (a : A), (VTask.ofLeftInverse h).symm (VTask.ofLeftInverse h a) = a

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) (A : Type*) (B : Type*) [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Semiring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] (g : B → A) (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (h : Function.LeftInverse g ⇑f) (b : ↥f.range), (VTask.ofLeftInverse h) ((VTask.ofLeftInverse h).symm b) = b

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) (A : Type*) (B : Type*) [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Semiring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] (g : B → A) (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (h : Function.LeftInverse g ⇑f) (a : A), ↑(VTask.ofLeftInverse h a) ∈ f.range
